feeds.title: Friday We're in Love
feeds.description: Date ideas to strengthen marriage and keep love alive with a weekly date night tips with family fun and family dates to create memories and experiences to last a lifetime. A blog by Camille Whiting - AZ lifestyle blogger, Friday night date planner, fun maker, mom to a miracle baby after years of infertility.

feeds.title: MomJunky.com
feeds.description: Travel. Parenting. Food. Green Beauty and how to stay on board the crazy train of motherhood. Lucee Santini is the author behind MomJunky and is also a contributor to the Huffington Post.

feeds.title: Desert Chica
feeds.description: I'm Karen - a mom to two boys, Arizona native, and travel lover. Desert Chica is a creative lifestyle blog featuring travel, DIY projects, social good, and food.

feeds.title: The Moonlit Nook
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog! My Nickname is Luna,I a wife and a Mother of two. I am a Blogger, Gamer, Crafter and a Nerd. I reside in Sunny Arizona where I grew up, I love spending time with my family,crafting,reading, & I love blogging. Being able to show others great new products, sharing travel tips, and hosting giveaways makes me happy it started as a hobby but now I consider it a part time job along side taking care of my family.

feeds.title: No Guilt Mom
feeds.description: On the blog, you'll find how to handle kid behavior like back talk and kids not listening. I'm JoAnn. I am a mom, a National Board Certified Teacher with my Masters in Education and now I'm here to help you.

feeds.title: Phoenix With Kids Blog
feeds.description: Your resource for honest reviews on kid places, events, activities, and more in Phoenix and Arizona! Phoenix With Kids lists 400+ activities, destinations, and reviews of kid friendly places all over Phoenix.

feeds.title: The love designed life
feeds.description: A modern motherhood lifestyle blog. I'm Paige, the blog focus on all things I love, including good design both in fashion home, natural healthy living, and raising our three babies in the Arizona desert.

feeds.title: Mom Style Lab
feeds.description: Mom Style Lab was created by a mom who loves fashion FOR moms or simply aspire to look their best. Created by Angela Keller, mom to eight-year-old Christina, MSL is designed to help identify looks that work for women and their lifestyle, streamline the shopping experience, and provide tips and tricks on how to dress best for you.

feeds.title: Working On Calm Blog
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Melissa. As an anxious mom in search of calm, I committed to learning to meditate, doing yoga, practicing gratitude, and finding pleasure in everyday moments. I started Working On Calm to explore the tools, techniques, and behaviors that can quiet an anxious mind and to create a positive community and resource for others in search of the same goal.

feeds.title: New Darlings
feeds.description: Hello! We are Robert and Christina, the husband and wife behind New Darlings. We live in Phoenix, Arizona with our baby boy Oliver. New Darlings started in 2013 as a place to document our move from New York to Arizona as newlyweds. Over the years we have traveled the world hand in hand, discovering new places and partnering with some amazing companies along the way.

feeds.title: AZ Mom Blog
feeds.description: AZ Mom Blog is about a blogging Mother and AZ native, who is sharing her knowledge with other moms on haircut tips, benefits, benefits of computer system risk assessment, quartz countertops, and more.

feeds.title: Lil' Luna
feeds.description: My name is Kristyn Merkley, and I'm married to my best friend Lo. We have six kids ages 4-14. Lilluna.com was born right after my second child in early 2010. I started sharing all of our favorite Mexican recipes I got from my mom, aunts, and grandma as well as some of the traditional American recipes that came from my dad's family. Since then, we have created 1500+ recipes to share here on the site.

feeds.title: Pulling Curls Blog
feeds.description: Hilary Erickson, BSN-RN has been a nurse since 1997 and has 20 years of labor and delivery experience. She shares her knowledge of all things pregnancy on this blog. Pulling Curls is the #1 Pregnancy Website created by an experienced labor nurse, and a podcast that untangles all things pregnancy & parenting.

feeds.title: Made New Mama Blog
feeds.description: Everything Faith, Health, Balance, Identity, and Peace for the young christian (single) mom. Blog sharing stories, wisdom, laughs, and encouragement. Made New Mama is more than just a mom blog but a place to grow your faith, challenge your perspective, and receive weekly encouragement that helps you move forward to a peace-filled life.

feeds.title: A Mom's Take
feeds.description: A Mom's Take is a mom blog that started in Phoenix, Arizona on April 1st, 2010 with just one mom trying to connect with others and be a resource for other moms. On this site, you will find a variety of topics from recipes, travel, crafts, gift ideas, blogging tips, and other content to inspire and teach.

feeds.title: Zona Girl Magazine
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Tara Kirkpatrick. I'm a Southwest-based freelance writer and amateur fashion illustrator who loves to focus on fashion, style, and inspiring people. A former Associated Press reporter, my work has appeared in national newspapers, online publications, and regional magazines, but this little blog is my forever labor of love.

feeds.title: Tastes Better From Scratch
feeds.description: Hi and welcome! I'm Lauren Allen, and this little corner of the web is my online kitchen! I'm the recipe creator, writer, and photographer behind everything you see here on 'Tastes Better From Scratch'. I'm so happy you stopped by! Browse hundreds of easy-to-make family-friendly recipes made from scratch that are big on flavor but short on difficulty.

feeds.title: Wildish Jess Blog
feeds.description: Wildish Jess is a blog full of parenting, beauty, health, travel, and lifestyle tips for the everyday woman.

feeds.title: ActiveMoms AZ
feeds.description: Active Moms has 14 years of serving families! Out and about with kids! Having fun, sharing tips, finding amazing places + awesome experiences. Their blogs have articles about parenting, teenage life, mom's life, family adventures, travel experiences, product reviews, and more.

feeds.title: All for the Boys
feeds.description: Allison Waken is a wife, mom, photographer, and blogger based out of Phoenix, Arizona. Her site, All for the Boys is a site dedicated to all of her boys. Visitors are encouraged to find inspiration to create, play, and interact with their families. The blog shares Activities, Ideas, Travel, Movies and Technology for Kids.

feeds.title: Mom Endeavors
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sara! I'm a mom of 3 boys and a former teacher who loves cooking, traveling, entertaining, and all sorts of creative activities. Over a decade ago, I launched Mom Endeavors - this family lifestyle site dedicated to sharing creative inspiration and practical tips for everyday endeavors and special family fun.

feeds.title: Momma Society
feeds.description: Momma Society is a community dedicated to helping modern moms from pregnancy through toddlerhood. Created by Certified Childbirth Expert Mandy Roberson, the Momma Society is the number one resource for all things birth, pregnancy, and motherhood.

feeds.title: Celebrating Family
feeds.description: Celebrating family is a place to find all things family. Content includes recipes, crafts, family activities, parenting tips, money-saving tips, and more. A site by Janice- an Arizona native, wife to a hard-working hubby, mom of two, and daughter of the King.

feeds.title: Sweet Shoppe Mom
feeds.description: We're Dana (mom) and Brendan (son) and we currently live in Phoenix, Arizona. We run the blog Sweet Shoppe Mom, where we write about everyday life with teens. We want to be the resource for busy families with tweens and teens.

feeds.title: Shaping Up To Be A Mom
feeds.description: Megan Tenney blogs all about family, fitness, and travel, and aims to inspire busy moms to find the time and energy to pursue their goals and dreams!

feeds.title: A Medley of Moments
feeds.description: Reflections on those little moments that make up our life. By Leisah Woldoff, a Phoenix freelance writer, blogger, and songwriter.

feeds.title: Real Time Mom Blog
feeds.description: Tips and tricks on maternity, food and health, baby essentials, nursery and more. Real Time Mom blog was started in 2017 by Nancy Fulkerson.

feeds.title: Eclectic Momsense
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kelly. A wife, mom, and jane of all trades. Just a little bit crafty, a smidgen of all things green, and a huge helping of everything mom! I began this endeavor as a way to chronicle family memories.

feeds.title: Reaj Roberts Photography Blog
feeds.description: Phoenix maternity, newborn, baby, and family photographer blog. I'm Reaj, and I photograph busy mamas who want to delegate the tedious juggle of photography details to a professional to create images that make them feel all the warm feels of motherhood and appear as if they've got it all together.

feeds.title: Married By His Grace
feeds.description: Hello and Welcome! I am Carmen Brown. I am passionate about marriage & parenting all under the grace of God. This is a place focused on our calling to the ministry as a wife, mom, and lover of His word. In between it all, I teach new bloggers how to build with a purpose.

feeds.title: Amy Davidson
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Amy Davidson. With this site, I plan on sharing everything from the newest nail polish color (ladies you know how extremely important this is to my favorite type of baby bottle, to stories of triumphs and failures and beyond. I will be blogging, sharing pictures and experiences, and creating a platform for all of you to interact as well.

feeds.title: A Cork, Fork, & Passport
feeds.description: Cork, Fork, & Passport is an Arizona-based online lifestyle magazine featuring recipes and dining, wine and spirits, family and luxury travel, home decor, and technology. All food and cocktail recipes are developed in our test kitchen by professional recipe developer, Julie Cohn. As writer and editor of A Cork, Fork, & Passport, Julie brings her personal perspective as a longtime travel agent and mother to all travel features, showcasing unique family and luxury travel ideas.

feeds.title: A Day In The Life Of Mom
feeds.description: A Day In The Life Of Mom is a resource for all moms. Here you will find recipes, crafts, natural living tips, parenting advice and more. Find lots of things to do with kids in Phoenix and surrounding areas.

feeds.title: Yay! Baby Blog
feeds.description: I am Angel. Mama to Jax, wife of Tim, curator of chaos. I post about anything that makes me smile which is basically FAMILY, FOOD, and FUN!

feeds.title: Candypolooza
feeds.description: I'm Candy, mother of two boys, and wife to my hubs of 17 years. I'm a writer, college student, wannabe fitness person- chef -entertainment critic, and traveler. Seriously just a lover of all things LIFE with family and a lot of fun. It's a wonderful life, my friends. Candypolooza is a lifestyle site written from a woman's point of view. Sharing all of the fun a military life, raising a family, and enjoying life via food, entertainment, and travel.

feeds.title: The Cactus Chronicles
feeds.description: From an early age, Kristi has loved traveling. Road trips with her parents throughout the U.S. and Canada led to backpacking through Italy and Spain. Settling down in Tucson, Arizona, and becoming a wife and mom hasn't stopped the busy Latina blogger from jet setting - her adventures now include trips to family-friendly destinations like Hawaii, family cruises, and theme parks like Disneyland, which she writes about on her personal blog, The Cactus Chronicles.

feeds.title: Phoenix Mom Blog
feeds.description: Kara is Arizona native and started Phoenix Mom Blog to share everything she loves about Phoenix and the great state of Arizona. Follow along on her journey as she guides you with the best places to shop, eat, stay and play!
